title: Pi: ccrider-observed session/message JSONL subset
description: Observed importer subset only. Tool-call argument fields, call/result linkage, branching and compaction payloads are not established by this reader; unknown fields are retained by this reference schema. This is a partial observational reference, not a vendor-certified or lossless ingestion schema. Unknown properties are allowed.

type.description: session header or message in the inspected importer; other native variants are not modeled.

id.description: Session ID on header; event ID on message record.

timestamp.description: Recorded timestamp string; preserve original representation, parse only when valid.

role.description: user, assistant, or toolResult are recognized by the importer.

anyOf.description: Text content where accepted by shared text decoder.

type.description: Content variant; only text is indexed by this importer.

timestamp.description: Numeric timestamp interpreted as milliseconds since Unix epoch by the inspected reader.
